name: A Diary
source:
Angel wrote so many things in her diary ever since her precious sister gave it to her, and these few pages are her last words...

[From [url=https://occultlily.itch.io/a-diary]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
自從最珍愛的姊妹把這本日記送給她，安琪爾就在裡面寫下了好多事。而這幾頁，是她最後留下的話……
